title: Runtime Lifecycle Event
description: Canonical evidence for model load/unload lifecycle events.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this payload shape.

event.description: Lifecycle event name: model_loaded, model_unloaded, server_started, server_stopped.

model_id_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the model identifier.

model_path_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the model path (not raw path).

loaded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the lifecycle event.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the lifecycle operation in milliseconds.

content_light.description: Content-light guarantee: no raw paths or secrets.
